property_summary: For every fuzzed lockTime/gift, once SetLogFile has been configured, any Put must invoke the configured log contract (here an EchoLog that, on its first AddMessage, donates 'gift' wei back to C), so address(c).balance becomes exactly gift; the mutant never stores the log address, so no AddMessage happens and C's balance stays 0.
change_summary: Remove the assignment to LogFile so the state variable is never set and remains address(0).
